mapper.sql: select o.*, (select count(1) from crm_sales_order_file f where f.order_id = o.id and f.del_flag = '0') as attachment_count, c.supplier_name as customer_name, s.supplier_name as supplier_name, cc.contact_name as customer_contact_name, sc.contact_name as supplier_contact_name from crm_sales_order o left join crm_supplier c on c.id = o.customer_id left join crm_supplier s on s.id = o.supplier_id left join crm_supplier_contact cc on cc.id = o.customer_contact_id left join crm_supplier_contact sc on sc.id = o.supplier_contact_id
mapper.select:
